notes: No source found reporting OIG-excluded or Medicare opt-out clinicians on the ASM participant list, or any program-integrity problem with the ASM roster. Coverage found is explainers from law firms, consultants and specialty societies (Benesch, Epstein Becker Green, Forvis Mazars, VBCA, ASA, ACS) on who must participate; per the 'Known pattern needs a finding' rule these are not recorded. A search summary gave the preliminary list as 6,637 clinicians (2,610 heart failure, 4,027 low back pain) but the page carrying that number was not identified, so it is not recorded; the lead's 6,510 may be the final list. Search summaries said the final list was expected summer/July 2026 and that ASM updates were proposed in the CY2027 Physician Fee Schedule on 2026-07-14; no post-cutoff article on the final roster was found. CMS ASM FAQ and data.cms.gov methodology page were fetched and say nothing about screening against the OIG exclusion list or the opt-out list. Seven queries run (not eight) to save shared budget.
